titulo: Rocking the Iron Curtain: How Queen’s 1986 Budapest concert cracked the Soviet Bloc
cuerpo: On 27 July 1986, a concert by British rock band Queen in Budapest symbolically tore down the Iron Curtain. A crowd of 80,000 filled the People's Stadium to feel the first wave of freedom. The band's official photographer Denis O'Regan recalls that night in an exclusive interview with Euronews.
